DHAKA, Aug 10, 2022 (BSS) - The Centre for Policy Dialogue (CPD) today proposed for re-fixing the fuel oil price alleging that the recent hike in fuel oil price has increased the living expenditures of low-income group people.

The civil society think tank also opined that the price hike has put a negative impact on the industrial and agricultural production as well.
